events.input: $ grep -n -i -E "webinar|event reminder|replay|apollo|meta|google" [redacted].tsx | head -80; git status --short [redacted].tsx; ls app/scripts | grep -i -E "rsp|board|fit|funnel" ; grep -n -i "publish held" coord/LOG.md 2>/dev/null | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Fetch each live script chunk and check for old and new labels
events.input: $ cd /tmp && head -3 chunks.txt; grep -o -E '(src|href)="[^"]+\.js"' rsp.html | head -5; n=0; for c in $(grep -o -E '"[^"]*_next/static/chunks/[^"]+\.js"' rsp.html | tr -d '"' | sort -u); do case $c in http*) u=$c;; /*) u="https://adisuja.github.io$c";; *) u="https://adisuja.github.[redacted]$c";; esac; code=$(curl -s -o c.js -w "%{http_code}" "$u"); a=$(grep -c "VSL re-watch nudge" c.js); b=$(grep -o -i -E "Webinar invite[^\"]{0,40}|Webinar reminder[^\"]{0,40}|Event reminder[^\"]{0,40}|Replay nudge[^\"]{0,40}" c.js | head -4 | tr '\n' '|'); echo "$code new=$a ol

events.name: Bash
events.head: Trace where the lowercase old phrases come from and where the new labels live
events.input: $ grep -rn -i -E "event reminder calls|replay nudge" app/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | cut -c1-220 | head; cd /tmp && grep -c "On-demand training" rsp.html; grep -o -E '[a-z0-9_-]+\.js' rsp.html | sort -u | wc -l; grep -o -i -E "re-watch[^\"<]{0,30}" rsp.html | head -3; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.[redacted].js" | grep -o -E ".{80}(event reminder calls|replay nudge).{60}" | head -3
